chapterTitle: Chapter 3: Synaptic Memoriam of a steel fossil shell
sceneTitle: Am I dreaming or am i dead
editorText:
Ringing pierced Tex’s ears with a strange bubbly static. It wasn’t a normal ringing. A strange Tinnitus he had never felt before. Like he had just jumped into a pool, but without the pressure of fluid pressing against him. The sound felt weightless in the sense that he could not feel the percussion, it was just there, untouchable.

It was like his ears were being born into existence for the first time, hearing the first sounds he had ever encountered. There was something entirely off. Like he was no longer a part of his own body, or any body.

All he could see was white. Eventually the ringing stopped, There was no taste, smell or feeling of weight he could connect with. He was weightless, almost senseless, but he was conscious. He could still feel, but only partially, he had no breath, or pulse, the only senses he felt were those his mind could construct. He wasn’t able to panic, he was at the complete mercy of whatever this was. He embraced the silence, it was the first peaceful moment he had felt in what seemed like an eternity. In the moment nothing could harm him, direct, or alter his state, even his own will.
